description: Minimum capability set (§13 rule 6): dialogs, fs scoped to the files the webview itself keeps under $DATA/querithm (tab recovery copies and the workspace, written to a temporary name and renamed into place, the folder listed for unsaved scripts to recover; app-bench results; reading the sidecar's exports) and user-picked paths. Nothing reaches the sidecar's store, known_hosts, logs or native libraries. No shell, no http. The webview may set its own page zoom (the Interface scale setting, §16).
